{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid motion sensors Type 2''' was a sensor package that enhanced [[Droid/Legends|droid]] vision and thereby allowed for an increased chance to detect organics hidden by [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth fields]]. This model was marketed mainly to manufacturers of [[Security droid/Legends|sentry]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|combat]] droids.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
